name: Orli Dahan
abstract_title: Embodied Evolution: The Impact of “Being in the Zone” During Birth on Psycho-Physical Outcomes
abstract: “Birthing consciousness” is a distinctive altered state of awareness that can emerge during physiological childbirth. This state closely aligns with the mental state of flow achieved during voluntary high-intensity physical activities, such as ultra-distance running or mountaineering — a deep absorption and focused engagement during an extreme psycho-physical challenge.
